description: Find GitLab users with smart pattern detection. Actions: search (find users by name/email/username with transliteration support), get (retrieve specific user by ID). Related: browse_members for project/group membership.

active.description: Filter for active (true) or inactive (false) users. Required for 'search' action(s).

blocked.description: Filter for blocked users. Required for 'search' action(s).

created_after.description: Filter users created after this date (ISO 8601). Required for 'search' action(s).

created_before.description: Filter users created before this date (ISO 8601). Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_active.description: Exclude active users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_external.description: Exclude external users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_humans.description: Exclude human users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_internal.description: Exclude internal system users. Required for 'search' action(s).

external.description: Filter for external users with limited access. Required for 'search' action(s).

humans.description: Filter for human users only (exclude bots). Required for 'search' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'search' action(s).

public_email.description: Find user by exact public email address. Required for 'search' action(s).

search.description: Partial text search across name, username, and email. Required for 'search' action(s).

smart_search.description: Enable smart search with auto-detection and transliteration. Auto-enabled for search parameter. Required for 'search' action(s).

user_id.description: User ID to retrieve. Required for 'get' action(s).

username.description: Exact username to search for. Case-sensitive. Required for 'search' action(s).

without_project_bots.description: Exclude project bot users. Required for 'search' action(s).

name: browse_users
